jobs.title: Project Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Join Excel Fluid Group

Project Solutions Engineer

This is a fulltime first shift position (Monday – Friday) 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM

Position Overview

The Project Solutions Engineer serves as an in-house engineering resource for the Business Development and Project Sales teams, with a focus on reviewing opportunities early, strengthening technical recommendations, and helping move qualified projects from initial review to a clearly scoped, specifiable solution. This role is intended to provide practical engineering judgment, support customer-facing technical credibility, and help give the buyer or specifying engineer confidence in EFG’s design recommendations.

The position supports the BD team by reviewing project information as opportunities come in, commenting on design considerations, identifying risks or gaps, and helping determine whether EFG’s recommended solution is technically appropriate. The role should keep the BD team involved in the customer relationship while reducing the time spent on detailed technical review, design interpretation, and engineering coordination.

For candidates with Professional Engineer licensure, this role may include responsible review and stamping of applicable project work once the individual has developed sufficient familiarity with EFG’s process, standards, products, and internal controls. Use of a professional stamp must be based on sound engineering judgment, proper review, and comfort with the scope of responsibility.

Responsibilities

Duties would include but not limited to:

Review specifications, drawings, and project data early in the opportunity process to evaluate feasibility, application fit, and technical risk.
Provide practical design comments and engineering recommendations that support BD discussions with buyers, engineers, and project stakeholders.
Help translate customer needs, site conditions, and project requirements into technically sound, cost-conscious system solutions.
Assess hydraulic, civil, electrical, structural, and site-specific considerations to identify concerns before proposals or recommendations are finalized.
Prepare early-stage documentation, including technical summaries, design assumptions, equipment recommendations, review notes, and preliminary layouts.
Prepare design reports, engineering review packages, and supporting documentation for review by external engineers or other qualified reviewers.
Participate in client calls, site visits, pre-bid discussions, and engineer-facing conversations when technical credibility or clarification is needed.
Collaborate with Business Development, Project Sales, internal engineering resources, and external subject matter experts to refine defensible system designs, proposal strategy, and project handoff.
Support responsible engineering review of applicable project work, including stamped work where appropriate based on licensure, review standards, and scope of responsibility.
Maintain current knowledge of EFG products, component manufacturers, industry standards, and application best practices.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or related engineering discipline required.
Active Professional Engineer license required or strongly preferred; Civil PE or PE with directly relevant water/wastewater, municipal infrastructure, pump station, or site development experience preferred.
5+ years of relevant experience in civil, water/wastewater, pump station, utility, or infrastructure-related engineering preferred.
Demonstrated ability to review plans, specifications, submittals, and project requirements and provide practical engineering recommendations.
Comfortable working directly with Business Development and Sales teams in a fast-moving opportunity environment.
Ability and willingness, where properly licensed and supported by adequate review, to take professional responsibility for applicable engineering work.
Solid understanding of pumps, hydraulics, site layout considerations, and project design coordination.
Excellent technical writing, communication, and judgment skills.

Additional Notes

Limitations and Disclaimer

The above job descriptions are meant to describe the general nature and level of work being performed; it is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required for the positions.

All job requirements are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health and safety of themselves or other employees.

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform other job-related duties requested by their supervisor in compliance with Federal and State Laws.

Requirements are representative of minimum levels of knowledge, skills and/or abilities. To perform this job successfully, the employee must possess the abilities or aptitudes to perform each duty proficiently. Continued employment remains on an “at-will” basis.

jobs.title: Safety Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Bengal is seeking an experienced Safety Compliance & Training Coordinator
to support employee onboarding, training, credential management, and workforce compliance.

This position works closely with Safety, Recruiting, Operations, Payroll, employees, and outside providers to ensure employees are properly screened, trained, documented, and cleared for work.

Hands-on experience with Alliance Safety Council and DISA is required.

Key Responsibilities

Maintain employee records, eligibility, and rosters within Alliance Safety Council and DISA.
Schedule and coordinate required training, including Safety Council, MSHA, OSHA 10/30, Security Passport, NCCER, NCCCO, and site-specific orientations.
Maintain employee certifications, assessments, and training records in FCC.
Run monthly FCC reports to identify upcoming expirations and coordinate required renewals or recertifications.
Assist with onsite new-hire onboarding and ensure required documentation is completed.
Create and maintain employee electronic files in SharePoint, including I-9 documentation, direct deposit forms, training cards, credentials, and certifications.
Submit background checks, run MVRs, coordinate drug screens, and track outstanding employee clearance requirements.
Coordinate weekly Cintas uniform service, including orders, exchanges, replacements, and returns.
Maintain safety-related spreadsheets, reports, rosters, and compliance records.
Communicate with employees, supervisors, training providers, and internal departments regarding missing or expiring requirements.

Required Qualifications

Experience with Alliance Safety Council and DISA.
Experience scheduling industrial safety training and maintaining employee compliance records.
Strong computer skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through.
Ability to manage multiple employees, deadlines, and expiration dates simultaneously.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Experience

FCC or similar training/compliance management system.
Microsoft SharePoint.
Familiarity with TWIC, NCCER, NCCCO, OSHA, MSHA, Security Passport, and industrial site-access requirements.

Position Details

Full-Time | Permanent | Monday-Friday | Onsite | Safety Department
